parts.problem_md:
Joe streams a radio show online.

Listeners can subscribe to get notifications about new shows.

Users who subscribe to Joe’s show are shown other content they could subscribe to.

Describe how an online service can offer the **most relevant** content to users.
parts.solution_md:
A linked description to include two from:

- Use cookies (1) that track/record user activity (1) that can be matched against similar content. (1)

parts.problem_md:
The venue promotes events on a website.

Describe **one **way the website can allow users to control the way their data is used.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description such as:
> 
> Users should be offered the right to opt out / prevent the use (1) of tracking/privacy features such as cookies (1)

parts.problem_md: Describe **one** personalisation technique the website could provide to users.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description such as:
> 
> - User profiles can be set (1) to adapt identifying information (name/image etc) (1)
> - Accessibility options can be set (1) to allow the site to be more user-friendly/readable (1)
> - Specific content can be shown/excluded (1) based on user preferences (1)

parts.problem_md:
Camille shares family photographs online with friends.

Describe how transactional data can be used with photographs stored online to improve the experience of users.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description such as:
> 
> - Cookies/transactional data can be used to store/read data about photographs/content/users viewed previously (1) so that similar/related photographs/content/users are shown/suggested (1)
